summary: Thin wrapper that reads a value through MutexProtectedValueReadWithTimeout and returns whether it is non-zero as a BOOL.

operations.description: Call MutexProtectedValueReadWithTimeout() to obtain the mutex-protected value.
Return whether the read value is non-zero, producing a BOOL result.

unresolved: Exact semantic of the non-zero return value (lock-held state vs protected value availability) is not derivable from this wrapper alone.
